name: Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set
summary: A run-to-failure and remaining-useful-life benchmark for fleets of aircraft engines generated with NASA's C-MAPSS simulator.

attributes.name: operation_1..3
attributes.description: Three operating settings that affect engine performance.

attributes.name: sensor_1..21
attributes.description: Twenty-one sensor channels describing engine condition.

attributes.name: RUL
attributes.description: Remaining operating cycles from the end of a test sequence to failure, stored in a separate RUL file.

notes: FD001 through FD004 differ in the number of operating conditions and fault modes.
Training sequences continue to failure; test sequences are censored before failure.
NASA does not specify a license in the dataset metadata, so this project does not classify it as CC0.
citation: Saxena, A. and Goebel, K. (2008). Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set. NASA Ames Prognostics Data Repository.
